text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a schema migration for user_profiles.next to add last_seen_index. Target window: Tue 03/30 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback plan. We'll run dual-write for ~2 hours then backfill.

aj: ack. curious about backfill volume — do we have row counts and an estimated token of time?

maria: quick query I ran: ```psql -h db-primary -c \"select count(*) from user_profiles where last_seen IS NULL;\"``` returned ~1.1M rows. at our usual batch rate that's ~90-120m total, but we'll parallelize per-shard.

ryan: I can own the deploy window. I'll coordinate canary on shard-1 then expand. plan: canary + smoke, then promote.

sara: +1. I'll own smoke checks: enrollment flow, profile reads, and embedding pipeline. Smoke checklist draft: 1) smoke user create/read 2) API latency < 200ms p95 3) no errors in serving logs 4) job queue drain after backfill.

aj: do we need to freeze writes or use dual-write? prefer dual-write for 2h then cutover. what's rollback surface?

maria: dual-write for 2h (write to user_profiles and user_profiles_v2). rollback plan: flip writes back to v1 only, stop backfill, run quick reconciliation job to delete partial v2 entries from canary shards if needed. we'll keep migration feature flag to toggle behavior.

ryan: deploy steps I'm thinking: 1) migrate ddl on replica (no lock) 2) deploy app with dual-write flag 3) enable dual-write on 10% traffic (canary) 4) monitor 30m, then 50%, 100% 5) start backfill job 6) validate counts & promote index.

sara: can you add the smoke `curl` checks I'll run? e.g.: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.dev/users/123/profile | jq '.last_seen'``` and a synthetic create: ```curl -X POST ... -d '{\"name\":\"smoke\"}'```

maria: added the curl checks in the runbook draft (https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/ENG/user_profiles_migration). also reserved the DB dual-write slot in infra calendar. deploy-bot: reserved window 2026-03-30T02:00Z-04:00Z for #eng-platform.

deploy-bot: calendar booking created by maria for user_profiles migration (slot id: DB-SLOT-8942).

aj: blockers? backups/pgdump schedule ok?

maria: pg_dump scheduled 01:00 UTC same day to S3. snapshot + WAL retention extended to 48h for the window.

ryan: I'll run canary and monitor. tagging @sara for smoke ownership and @aj for post-backfill validation.

sara: got it. I'll prepare dashboards: error rate, p95 latency, jobs-in-flight.

aj: one more ask — if backfill spikes DB CPU, can we pause it per-shard? we should be able to throttle.

maria: yes backfill supports per-shard concurrency. fallback: reduce workers or pause queue. I'll document commands in runbook.

ryan: cool. i'll send a final pre-deploy ping 24h before and a go/no-go 2h before window. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect. thanks everyone. leaving notes in the runbook and tagging infra for extra read-rep capacity.

sara: :thumbsup:

ryan: 👍

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen with pre-deploy checklist updates.
